claims.text: Remaining useful life is about 96 cycles (10th-90th percentile 73-108) by the ML model; the health-index trend gives 40.
The two RUL methods differ by 55 cycles (limit 20); treat the estimate as uncertain.
Most likely fault mode: HPC degradation (probability 1.00).
Sensors pulling the RUL estimate down most: T24 (lpc), Ps30 (hpc), W31 (hpt).

3 similar past removals in case memory (FD001-H016 at cycle 209, FD001-H035 at cycle 181, FD003-H090 at cycle 181); the shop found HPC stage 1-3 blades eroded, tip clearance beyond limits on all 3, after removal for performance deterioration, EGT margin exhausted.
SB-TF-72-0142 3.B (service bulletin) takes precedence over AMM-TF-R3 72-31-00 (manual) on the same topic; SB recommended; adopting it needs engineering approval.
Recommended, needs engineering approval: SB-TF-72-0142 3.B (service bulletin, compliance recommended, no fleet decision yet).

Reference: AD-2026-17-04 (g) (airworthiness directive, conditions not met: RUL lower bound 33 ≥ 30 cycles); AMM-TF-R3 05-20-00 (manual); AMM-TF-R3 72-31-00 (manual, the plan follows it until engineering decides on SB-TF-72-0142 3.B, which would replace it on this topic).
Inspection finding EV-INS-01 (borescope, HPC stage 3, cycle 152): blade tip erosion 0.42 mm is within the serviceable limit 0.5 mm of AMM-TF-R3 72-31-00-601: within limits.

Inspection finding EV-INS-01 on the HPC is within limits: the wear the sensors attribute to HPC degradation has not reached the manual's limits there, which weakens the case for removal on the sensor reading alone.

recommendation.action: No removal (borescope, HPC stage 3 within limits); next borescope by the deadline

rationale.text: Deadline 2026-11-07 is the RUL lower bound 33 cycles at 2 cycles/day.
Trigger severity moderate: planning lower bound 33 cycles (min(A 10th percentile 73, B lower 33); severe < 25, moderate < 80).
Inspection finding EV-INS-01 is within limits per AMM-TF-R3 72-31-00-601: it answers the inspection the brief would otherwise ask for, so no removal; the next inspection is due by 2026-11-07.
Selected tasks need TF-GEN-8101 (need 1, 25 on hand, 5 d lead). In-stock substitutes do not replace a short required part.
World Model task FM-HPC-01: Borescope inspection HPC stages 1-9; reinspect at standard interval.
Limits and intervals for FM-HPC-01 follow AMM-TF-R3 72-31-00 (manual); SB-TF-72-0142 3.B (service bulletin) would replace it on that topic: SB recommended; adopting it needs engineering approval.
Work package (asset-pack templates, synthetic task references): borescope inspection on wing by 2026-11-07 (4 tasks, 1 RII, 4.5 manhours); 4.5 manhours in all.
World Model lists tasks for this fault (FM-HPC-01, FM-HPC-02, FM-HPC-03, FM-HPC-04, FM-HPC-05, FM-HPC-06); the plan uses FM-HPC-01.

World Model links these document sections to tasks for this fault: AD-2026-17-04 (g)→FM-HPC-01, AMM-TF-R2 72-31-00→FM-HPC-01, AMM-TF-R3 71-00-00→FM-HPC-06, AMM-TF-R3 72-31-00→FM-HPC-01, AMM-TF-R3 72-31-10→FM-HPC-02, SB-TF-72-0142 3.B→FM-HPC-01; which apply now and which are mandatory is decided by the knowledge agent.

agents.name: intake
agents.role: Reads the question and resolves the engine, or asks back

agents.name: planner
agents.role: Assigns round 1, delegates follow-ups the findings call for, routes each gap to the agent that can fix it

agents.name: data
agents.role: Telemetry, input plausibility, history, schedule, slots, entered inspection findings; inspection history and targeted re-queries

agents.name: prognostics
agents.role: RUL methods A and B, SHAP drivers, anomaly flag; back-test at the last inspection

agents.name: diagnostics
agents.role: Fault-mode match and similar past cases; checks both candidates when unclear; checks an inspection finding against the fault mode

agents.name: knowledge
agents.role: Applicable documents in precedence order, mandates decided in code; the limit section for each inspection finding, compared in code; binds a missing mandate

agents.name: maint_planner
agents.role: Task, parts, slot and deadline from the RUL lower bound; applies the routed fixes

agents.name: rule_checks
agents.role: Deterministic gate: citations, numbers, parts, slots, deadlines, mandates

agents.name: critic
agents.role: Deterministic checks, then Nemotron challenges that code confirms or refutes

agents.name: escalation
